videos.title: WWDC25: Design foundations from idea to interface | Apple
videos.why: Apple's own session on structure, navigation, content and visual design for an app, the conventions iPhone users expect.

videos.title: Build next-level UX with Material 3 Expressive
videos.why: Google's Material team explains the research and new guidelines behind the current Android look, useful to compare with Apple's approach.

podcasts.episode: Material Design Gets Expressive: Inside Google's Emotion-Driven UX Update
podcasts.why: Members of the Material team on how the latest Android design update was shaped by user research.

reads.title: iOS vs. Android App UI Design: The Complete Guide
reads.why: Compares the same patterns on each platform, including navigation, buttons, typography and icons, with screenshots to train your eye for the differences.

reads.title: Designing for iOS
reads.why: Apple's short summary of the iPhone's display, ergonomics, inputs and typical usage patterns, and the best practices that follow from them.

reads.title: Start building with Material 3 Expressive
reads.why: Google's introduction to the current Material update, covering new and updated components, spring-based motion and the research behind them.
